GraceRequirements.Annotation: Flutter app that reads Gran Turismo 7 telemetry over UDP and shows it next to the game's own service data (daily races, car dealerships, GT Auto) on mobile and desktop.
GraceRequirements.Keywords: gt7, telemetry, flutter, dart, racing, udp, salsa20, daily-races, car-dealer

Goals.Goal: Display live GT7 telemetry (speed, gears, tyres, lap and throttle/brake traces) with low latency and no perceptible stutter.
Show the game's service side in the same app: daily races from two independent sources, used and legendary car dealerships, and GT Auto counters.
Keep the same feature set on mobile and desktop from one Dart codebase, with the app running alongside the game on a second screen.

Users.User: Gran Turismo 7 players who run this app on a phone, tablet or desktop next to the console while racing.

Constraints.Constraint: Telemetry arrives as the game's UDP broadcast and is decrypted with Salsa20; protocol parsing stays inside lib/services and never moves into widgets.
Service-side data comes from third-party sources (dg-edge, gt-sh, gt7info, GTDB) that are scraped politely: fixed timeouts, crawl delay, no aggressive retry loops.
PSN authentication tokens are secrets: they are stored in SharedPreferences and must be masked in every log line.
Only a dark, GT7-styled presentation is supported; there is no light theme or ThemeMode switch.
The Flutter SDK is pinned per project through FVM (.fvm/flutter_sdk, .fvmrc); builds must use that SDK rather than whatever is on PATH.
